name: uccif
description: Task memory, token line, project notes and CodeGraph setup for any repository. Same core as the UCCIF Claude Code plugin. Never blocks.

settings.name: Reply language
settings.description: Language Gemini uses when replying to you (framework files stay English). Example: vi, en.

settings.name: Token line
settings.description: true or false: one line with the real token usage after each reply.

settings.name: Automatic project setup
settings.description: true or false: index each project with CodeGraph in the background and write project skills to .agents/skills/.
